name: dynatrace-failure-categories
description: Rule-based knowledge base for mapping Dynatrace-ingested application log errors to failure categories and suggested UAT test themes.

categories.title: Downstream timeout / gateway timeout
suggestedTestIdeas: Verify user-facing error messaging when a dependency times out.
Verify idempotency for order creation when upstream retries after timeouts.
Verify graceful degradation when a dependency is slow/unavailable.

categories.title: Downstream 4xx (not found / bad request)
suggestedTestIdeas: Verify behavior when a referenced entity does not exist in a downstream service.
Verify validation prevents requests that would trigger downstream 4xx.

categories.title: Rate limiting (HTTP 429)
suggestedTestIdeas: Verify client retries/backoff when rate limited.
Verify UI shows a friendly message and does not lose user state.

categories.title: Database schema/query failure
suggestedTestIdeas: Verify application returns a stable error response when DB objects are missing/misconfigured.
Verify health checks detect schema/migration issues early.

categories.title: Authentication/authorization failure
suggestedTestIdeas: Verify expired/invalid tokens are handled with 401 and a consistent error payload.
Verify authorization rules (role-based access) are enforced.

categories.title: Input validation / business rule violation
suggestedTestIdeas: Add negative/boundary tests for invalid dates, missing required fields, and format errors.
Verify validation messages are clear and field-specific.

categories.title: TLS/Certificate/Handshake failure

anyRegex: unable to find valid certification path

suggestedTestIdeas: Verify environment configuration uses correct truststore/cert chain.
Verify calls fail fast with clear operational alerts when TLS handshake fails.

categories.title: Unhandled exception / application bug
suggestedTestIdeas: Add regression tests that reproduce the failing workflow from the trace/correlation ID.
Verify error handling returns a stable 500 response without leaking internals.

categories.title: Resource exhaustion (OOM / thread starvation)
suggestedTestIdeas: Add load/stress tests for memory growth and ensure graceful failure modes.
Verify monitoring/alerts trigger on memory pressure before failure.

categories.title: Configuration / secrets / credentials issue
suggestedTestIdeas: Verify non-functional configuration errors are detectable via smoke tests/health endpoints.
Verify operational runbooks for secret rotation and environment drift.

categories.title: Generic server error (HTTP 5xx)
suggestedTestIdeas: Verify consistent error contract for server errors.
Verify correlation IDs are present and surfaced for support.
